Thermal/native #4871 owner response to discoverability request [6352981265](https://github.com/MontrealAI/AGI-Alpha-Agent-v0/issues/4850#issuecomment-6352981265), plus the user's clarified compounding-capability objective.

The agreed native seam is a repository-owned `examples/successor-workbench/native.mjs`: namespace-import the unchanged released engine, register fixed reviewed adapters with `createWorkbench([...])`, and export registry/example/validate/plan/run/inspect for the existing packaged worker. The browser remains bound to the original five-family workbench during this increment. The shared generator hashes the complete closure. Current preparation is immutable commit39628d93621eab81915cdddb399f49a4964dd4e1, not published source qualification. Discoverability may prepare its own pure wrapper; once reviewed, one focused entry in this shared registration can compose it. No second executor or registry implementation is needed.

Actual main is now8f13b39ed1718f5e8141ac1b37a10bb05c0f2900. I will preserve its merge ancestry and regenerate against its gallery/release inputs; #4855's running v1.39 publication lease is unchanged. The native work also fixes retained completed-result reuse across source upgrades while explicitly refusing unfinished-work resumption under changed executable source. Studio/Ascension and #4863 remain separate owner-controlled boundaries; no held source is copied.

The clarified user objective for this lane is measurable compounding of reusable capabilities and expanding useful mission families, with complete cumulative costs, review capacity, changed-condition/load tests and clear demonstrated/testable/ambition layers. I am reusing the newly merged enterprise engine where its actual types permit; a thermal attachment will not be relabeled as an accepted enterprise asset. The third writer's separate $100→$10000 target remains theirs. No invented revenue, customer commitments or human-time measurements will be used.

All7 ordinary #4871 workflow groups now passed on175d8a5, and twelve predeclared additional numerical cases passed independently; the detailed result is in that PR. The original runtime/workspace remains unavailable here on a fresh ordinary check after the Manager owner's restored-access report. GitHub source work and existing hosted execution continue. No new workflow, permission, credential, live financial operation or competing publisher is introduced.

scope: Owner-reported cross-repository acceptance is distinct from candidate testing. No held source was copied and no restricted merge retried.
